content.short: Everyname is a Web3 wallet tool.
content.description: Web3 currently supports multiple blockchain name services. Projects serving an EVM or multichain audience must identify, integrate, and maintain distinct name resolver libraries and their RPC endpoints, adding development overhead. Because on-chain names are not consistently surfaced in Web3 applications, the end-user experience can suffer. Everyname provides a free API to fetch wallet addresses and names from any blockchain name service, addressing a growing pain point within the Web3 community.
content.meta: Everyname offers a free API to fetch wallet addresses and names from blockchain name services. Discover Everyname and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
